subject: Evans Street Infrastructure and Sidewalk Funding Appropriation
overview: The Council approved a $500,000 appropriation for citywide sidewalk repairs and stump removals and addressed severe road degradation on Evans Street. The body also authorized utility upgrades on High Street and approved licenses for automotive repair and residential fuel storage.

items.title: A&E Auto Repair Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved a Class 4 license for automotive repair and a body shop at 67 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Evans Street Neighborhood Road Conditions
items.summary: Passed a motion requesting a repaving plan, cost estimate, and timeline for Evans Street after residents presented evidence of hazardous road conditions.

items.title: Cabot Road Flammable Storage License
items.summary: Approved a flammable storage license for a 579-car parking garage associated with a new residential development at 5 Cabot Road.

items.title: National Grid Gas Main Replacement
items.summary: Approved a gas main replacement project on High Street with requirements for curb-to-curb restoration and traffic management coordination.

items.title: National Grid Pole Relocation
items.summary: Approved the relocation of a utility pole at the Winthrop Street rotary to improve traffic safety at a high-accident location.

items.title: Remembrance of Firefighter Timothy Brennan
items.summary: Dedicated the meeting and observed a moment of silence for Firefighter Timothy Brennan on the one-year anniversary of his passing.

items.title: A&E Auto Repair Class 2 License
items.summary: Tabled a petition for a Class 2 auto dealer license at 67 Mystic Avenue because the petitioner was no longer present in the chamber.

items.title: Petition on City Infrastructure Policy
items.summary: Referred a citizen petition concerning unused MWRA infrastructure grants and project implementation backlogs to the City Engineer and Mayor for response.

items.title: Committee Report on Municipal Aggregation
items.summary: Received and placed on file a committee report regarding the proposed municipal electrical aggregation plan.

items.title: Condolence for Reverend Francis Garrity
items.summary: Offered condolences and observed a moment of silence for Reverend Francis Garrity, former chaplain of the Medford Police Department.

items.title: Republic Parking Enforcement on Gaston Street
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting that Republic Parking waive tickets issued to residents on the first day of seasonal enforcement if they purchase a valid permit.

items.title: National Grid Fourth Street Steel Plates
items.summary: Requested an update from National Grid regarding the status of work and the removal of long-standing steel plates on Riverside Avenue and Fourth Street.

items.title: Appropriation for Sidewalks and Tree Stumps
items.summary: Approved a $500,000 appropriation from free cash to remove 192 tree stumps and repair hazardous sidewalks across the city. A related motion passed requesting an assessment of Evans Street utilities prior to its repaving.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the meeting from May 28, 2016.
